Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NotAStand: There is no empty Tank Stand here.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoBarrel: Needs a rain barrel, picked up and carried.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_BarrelNotEmpt: The barrel must be empty to lift it onto the stand.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoBarrelOnSta: There is no barrel on this stand.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_EmptyBarrelFi: Empty the barrel before taking it down.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_TankGone: That tank is no longer there.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_OutOfReach: That tank is too far away to plumb to.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_AlreadyPlumbe: These tanks are already plumbed together.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NotPlumbed: These tanks are not plumbed together.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoPipe: Needs pipe to lay: plastic, iron or lead pipe, or clay pipe segments.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_CantLayHere: A line can't be laid here: it needs open, dry ground or floor.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoTankReach: Start a line beside a tank or a pump, or lay it on from a line already laid.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_JoinsTwoFeeds: This would join two lines that each have a tap or a pump.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoLine: There is no garden line here.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoHoleMaker: Needs a tool that pierces this pipe: a hand drill for iron; an auger, a stone drill or a hammer and a nail for clay; an awl too for plastic and lead.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_MayCrack: Punching holes may crack this pipe.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_LineHasTap: This line already has a tap.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_LinePumped: A pump already feeds this line.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_LineRunning: Its pump is running water through the line.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_TapAndSprinkl: A tap and a sprinkler can't share a tile.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_HasSprinkler: This tile already has a sprinkler.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoSprinkler: Needs a Lawn Sprinkler in your inventory.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoSprinklerHe: There is no sprinkler on this tile.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_LawnSprinkler: A rotary lawn sprinkler. Set it on a garden line tile: while a pump drives the line it waters every bed in a 5 by 3 patch around it, fast and wastefully. A tank's head alone won't turn it.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_MakePipeSprin: An iron pipe drilled for a riser, with a spray can's nozzle for a head. It won't come out as good as a bought one.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_TapInUse: Someone is already at this tap.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_PumpInUse: Someone is already working this pump.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoPressure: The tank must stand a storey above the line.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_FixtureNoPres: The tank must stand a storey above the fixture.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_FixturePlumbe: This fixture is already plumbed to a tank.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_CisternsForKe: A University of Kentucky extension leaflet on keeping and moving farm water: a barrel on a log stand for pressure, tanks piped together to share what the rain gives, and a slow sand filter to make it safe to drink.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_TankStand: A log tower a storey high. A rain barrel set on its deck stands high enough to water a garden line below.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_BarrelFilter: A barrel of sand over gravel and charcoal. Raw water poured on top seeps through slowly; once the sand has ripened for three days of steady use, what comes out is safe to drink.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_BrickFilter: A brick tank of sand over gravel and charcoal, with four times a barrel filter's water. Once the sand has ripened for three days of steady use, what comes out is safe to drink.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoWaterCarrie: Needs a container of water in your inventory.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_HeadFull: It is full to the brim.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_InletTankTooL: The tank must stand at least level with it for water to run in.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_OutletTankToo: The tank must stand no higher than it for water to run out.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_FilterCrock: A Filter Crock set in an empty bucket. Raw water poured into the crock seeps through its walls into the bucket, clean, about 10 L a day. Keep it from a hard frost while it holds water.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_ShapeFilterCr: A wide, unglazed pot thrown with charcoal crushed into the clay, which burns out in the kiln and leaves pores fine enough to strain water clean.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_FilterCrockUn: Fire it in a kiln to make a Filter Crock.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_FilterCrockIt: A porous clay pot. Set it in an empty bucket from the build menu, pour raw water in, and clean water seeps into the bucket.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_CrockCracked: The crock is cracked. Take it down and fire a new one.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_Boiler: A Metal Drum over a firebox. Fuel and light it like any fire; raw water poured or piped into the drum comes out clean once it has been hot for an hour, about 30 L an hour while the fire lasts. Build it outdoors, clear of walls. Don't let it burn dry.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_BurntThrough: The drum is burnt through. Patch it first.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_DrumWornOut: The drum is too patched to take another. Build a new boiler.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_DrumSound: The drum is sounder than a patch would leave it.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_WoodenHandPum: A plank hand pump with a leather, rubber or tarp seal. Build it beside a well, a barrel or a trough, or within 3 tiles of a river for its hose, then plumb its outlet to a tank up to a storey above it or to a garden line, and work the handle: about 6 L a minute. It squeals, and the wood wears.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_IronHandPump: An iron hand pump with a leather, rubber or tarp seal. Build it beside a well, a barrel or a trough, or within 3 tiles of a river for its hose, then plumb its outlet to a tank up to two storeys above it or to a garden line, and work the handle: about 8 L a minute.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_LiftsOneStore: This pump lifts water one storey: the tank can stand no higher than a storey above it.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_LiftsTwoStore: This pump lifts water two storeys: the tank can stand no higher than two storeys above it.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoOutlet: Plumb its outlet to a tank or a garden line first.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_OutletGone: What its outlet fed is no longer there.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_OutletFull: The tank it fills is full.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoWaterToDraw: No water to draw: it needs a well, a barrel or a trough with water beside it, or a river within reach of its hose.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_SealWornOut: The seal is worn out: the pump squeals and lifts nothing. Replace Seal.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_PumpWornOut: The pump is worn out. Knock it down with a sledgehammer and build a new one.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoSeal: Needs a seal: Leather Strips, a Tire Piece, a Tarp Piece or a Plunger.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_Exhausted: Too exhausted to work the pump.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_PumpHouse: A box wired for one pump. Fit an Appliance Pump or a Utility Pump, build it beside a well, a barrel or a trough or within 3 tiles of a river for its hose, plumb its outlet to a tank or a garden line, and switch it on: it runs while it has power from the grid (in or beside a room, before the shutoff) or a generator, which burns fuel for it.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_AppliancePump: A washing machine's drain pump. Fit it in a Pump House: about 6 L a minute, a storey up. It wasn't made to run for long.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_UtilityPump: An electric utility pump. Fit it in a Pump House: about 20 L a minute, up to two storeys up.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_MakeUtilityPu: A Blower Fan's motor driving a welded steel impeller in a screwed housing. It won't come out as good as a bought one.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoPumpFitted: Fit an Appliance Pump or a Utility Pump first.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_PumpFitted: A pump is already fitted. Take it out first.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoPumpPart: Needs an Appliance Pump or a Utility Pump in your inventory.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_PumpBurntOut: The pump is burnt out. Repair it, or take it out and fit another.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_PumpTooRepair: The pump has been repaired too often to take another. Fit a new one.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_PumpSound: The pump is sounder than a repair would leave it.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_WaterValveIte: A washing machine's water inlet valve: a coil opens it while it has power. Wire it to an alarm clock for a Timer Valve.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_WindUpValveIt: A kitchen timer that pinches a hose shut as it runs down. Fit it to a garden line's tap and wind it: the tap runs for the minutes you give it, with nobody holding it.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_TimerValveIte: An alarm clock wired to a water valve. Fit it to a garden line's tap or a Pump House and set it: every day it runs the tap or the pump at the hour you pick, for the minutes you pick, while it has power.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_SprinklerTime: A plug-in garden timer. Fit it to a garden line's tap or a Pump House and set it: every day it runs the tap or the pump at the hour you pick, for the minutes you pick, while it has power.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_MakeWindUpVal: A kitchen timer screwed to a length of hose it pinches shut as it runs down.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_MakeTimerValv: An alarm clock wired to open a water valve at its hour each day.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_HasValve: The tap already has a valve. Take it off first.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoValve: Needs a Wind-up Valve, a Timer Valve or a Sprinkler Timer in your inventory.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoValveHere: There is no such valve on this tap.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_ValveRunning: The tap's valve is running it.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_HasTimer: A timer is already fitted. Take it off first.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoTimer: Needs a Timer Valve or a Sprinkler Timer in your inventory.
